commit committer identity

  • CURIE: gmeow:commitCommitterIdentity
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/commitCommitterIdentity
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/software

The recorded committer identity of a commit — the raw historical bytes. Distinct from gmeow:committedBy, which points to the canonical agent currently understood to have committed the changes.

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:Commit -> gmeow:AuthorIdentity; functional

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:commitCommitterIdentity from gmeow:Commit to gmeow:AuthorIdentity when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:Commit, gmeow:AuthorIdentity
